about: Committed search-eval floor. baseline: the token ranking before hybrid search (fixed). keyword / hybrid: keyword-only and keyword + semantic (committed fixture vectors) with the FTS5 keyword half, run where SQLite has FTS5. keyword_js / hybrid_js: the same with the JS BM25 keyword half, run everywhere. search-eval.test.mjs fails when a run drops below its floor, or a hybrid run does not beat baseline.
